# claude.md - Post Collection Flow (tree 173598167)

Unlinked memory node. Read FIRST before editing; update every edit session.
Quest Diagnostics / Delta - agent form that writes post-collection details back to the
Salesforce Event via Connected Object 447, launched from the Delta tree's OSM email link
(https://zingtree.com/live/173598167?zv_sf_Id=...#910).

## PII / PHI + COMPLIANCE NOTICE
Captures breath-alcohol test results, specimen/CCF IDs, DER (Designated Employer Rep)
notifications, and pushes them to Salesforce. PII/PHI sensitive. Any LIVE publish/import must
be teammate-reviewed per Zingtree policy before shipping.

## Node map
- 910 Content (root)  Post Collection Info - Salesforce Update (all native form fields) -> 913
- 913 Script          Submit post-collection info (converts time-of-day fields to SF format) -> 911
- 911 Data            Update SF Event (Connected Object 447, salesforce) -> 912
- 912 Content         Handle response / success screen
- 914 Content         claude.md (this node, unlinked)

## Form fields on node 910 (all native; auto-pass to Connected Object 447 by exact name)
Existing: sf_Id, sf_Collector_Arrival_Time_Actual__c, sf_End_Time_Actual__c,
  sf_FedEx_Tracking_for_ES_24_7__c, sf_ATF_Number__c, sf_BAT_Test_Number__c ("Test # on
  Printout"), sf_BAT_Result__c, additional_paperwork (file).
Added 2026-07-28:
  - sf_BAT_Collection_Time_Actual__c (time select, converted in node 913)
  - sf_BAT_Collection_Time_Zone__c (select ET/CT/MT/PT/AKT/HT)
  - sf_Test_Number__c (text, "Test Number") - DISTINCT SF field from sf_BAT_Test_Number__c
  - sf_BAT_Positive__c (Yes/No) *placeholder name - confirm SF field*
  - sf_DER_Notified__c (Yes/No, shown only when sf_BAT_Positive__c == Yes) *placeholder name*
  - sf_DER_Notified_At__c (combined datetime, shown only when BAT positive == Yes; built as a
    text field with a format hint because a native datetime token is not proven in org exports
    - author can switch to a native datetime picker in the editor if available) *placeholder*
  - sf_Paperwork_Sent_to_Delta__c (Yes/No) *placeholder name*

## SF time conversion (node 913)
toSalesforceTime() converts 12h/24h time-of-day selects to HH:MM:SS.000Z. Converts
sf_Collector_Arrival_Time_Actual__c, sf_End_Time_Actual__c, and (added)
sf_BAT_Collection_Time_Actual__c. sf_DER_Notified_At__c is a FULL datetime and is NOT run
through this time-of-day converter.

## Conventions / gotchas
- script_code (tree-level) restyles nodes 910/912 and locks the sf_Id field read-only;
  it detects node 910 by the presence of arrival/end/fedex field names - safe to add fields.
- Native fields only (they inherit styling + enforce required). Connected Object alias/name
  matching is by exact variable name.

## OPEN ITEM (Connected Object 447 mapping - verify in Salesforce, cannot be fixed from tree JSON)
- Chris reported sf_BAT_Test_Number__c ("Test # on Printout") types in but does not reach
  Salesforce. Per Brent, BOTH sf_BAT_Test_Number__c AND sf_Test_Number__c are real, distinct
  SF fields; the not-saving issue is likely that the input was on the wrong name. Verify BOTH
  map to the correct SF field API names on Connected Object 447. Do NOT rename/hack in the tree.
- Placeholder field names above (sf_BAT_Positive__c, sf_DER_Notified__c, sf_DER_Notified_At__c,
  sf_Paperwork_Sent_to_Delta__c) are working names Brent may rename once their SF fields are
  confirmed; re-verify their Object 447 mapping after any rename.

  - B2: added sf_BAT_Collection_Time_Actual__c to the node 913 SF-time converter.
  - B3: recorded the Connected Object 447 test-number mapping open item (above).
  - Added this claude.md node (id 914).
